articleTitle: Research on Port Tugboat Scheduling Optimization Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Aiming at the configuration of tugboats in Xiamen port, this paper establishes a weighted multi-objective optimization model of tugboat scheduling. The optimization objectives are ship waiting time and tugboat operating cost, and the genetic algorithm is used to solve the model. Experimental results show that the scheduling model can effectively reduce the waiting time of the arrival ship and the waste of the tug's horsepower. On this basis, an elite set is added to improve the genetic algorithm, which improves the convergence speed and global optimization ability of the algorithm, thus shortening the execution response time of the algorithm in the process of scheduling optimization.

articleTitle: Microbial Fermentation Optimal Control Method Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Microbial fermentation is a typical microbial fermentation process. Microbial bacteria ingest the nutrients of raw materials in the fermentation tank. Under appropriate conditions, enzymes in the body catalyze complex biochemical reactions to produce microorganisms. In order to guarantee the quality of modeling data and meet the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data quality requirements, it needs to preprocess the input and output data. In this paper, the parameter model is solved by the particle swarm algorithm. Updating the parameter value of the next moment in real time constitutes a feedback correction to the prediction model. Theil inequality approach is adopted to test the tracking performance of the above model's adaptive correction method. The Monte Carlo method is applied to generate multiple groups of different kinetic model values, which are substituted into the fermentation kinetic model as the real model parameter values. After the experimental analysis, the measured value of the model established by the method in this paper is closer to the predicted value, which has the effect of feedback correction and optimal control. The external conditions in the fermentation process are optimally controlled to achieve the effects of shortening the production period. It improves the yield of fermentation terminal target products and reduces the consumption of raw materials.

articleTitle: Optimization of Materials Delivery in Mobile Cabin Hospitals Based on Agent Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Facing the spread of COVID-19, China has built numerous mobile cabin hospitals. Due to the tight construction period, the construction process has faced problems such as site congestion, low efficiency in material delivery, presence of potential safety hazards, etc. In this article, an agent-based simulation model is constructed by abstracting the manpower and vehicle resources in the construction process of mobile cabin hospital into agents. The optimization objective function is constructed by taking the total transportation time and resource vacancy rate as indicators, and is solved by genetic algorithm, which effectively optimizes the resource allocation of the project and improves the efficiency of material transportation. The practical application in Shanghai Jinshan Mobile Cabin Hospital and other projects show that the model has the characteristics of simple modeling and fast convergence speed. Therefore, the proposed method can provide intuitive decision-making means for materials transportation in the construction process of the mobile cabin hospital, and has reference significance for similar projects.

articleTitle: A Recommender System for Reinforcement Learning Based on Label Value Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: As a very important application scenario, the combination of reinforcement learning and recommendation system has been closely concerned by all sectors of society. In this paper, we propose a Contextual quantile regression reinforcement learning model by using value distribution reinforcement learning and label distribution learning methods, adopting nonlinear reinforcement learning methods and combining the personalized requirements of the recommendation system; And from the perspective of the system, the relevant characteristics of the improved model are analyzed and the overall design is carried out; Finally, the simulation experiment is carried out by simulating the real recommendation environment, and different models are used for comparative analysis. Through experimental research and comparative analysis, it can be seen that the accuracy, data utilization, robustness, model convergence speed and stability of the recommendation system with nonlinear expectation idea have been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Time Series Prediction of Energy Consumption in Marine Ranching Based on GAN and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In recent years, our Marine economy has been rapidly developed, and the proportion of our national economy has been increasing year by year, but it faces deep structural imbalance, mainly because of the high energy consumption industry in our Marine economy, Marine ranching is one of them. Only through the study of energy consumption can we improve energy efficiency and management level, and then reduce energy consumption. Therefore, the energy consumption research of Marine ranches is imminent. For a long time, the lack of research on the prediction of energy consumption of Marine ranching has been restricting the scientific management of Marine ranching and the improvement of energy consumption efficiency. To solve this problem, a time series prediction model based on generative adversarial network (GAN) and Long Term and Short Term memory network (LSTM) was proposed for the prediction of energy consumption in Marine ranching. Firstly, the generative adversarial network is used to enhance the data set and generate new data, so as to improve the measurement accuracy. Then, the long-term and short-term memory neural network is used to predict the future energy consumption. Finally, in order to verify the validity of the model, the data set of a Marine ranching was used for experiments and compared with the SVR model and LSTM model. Experimental results show that compared with other models, GAN-LSTM has higher accuracy in predicting data, and the data predicted by GAN- LSTM is often more real and accurate than that by traditional models.

Author Keywords: Long and short term memory network

articleTitle: Mobile Communication Network Site Planning and Regional Clustering Based on Greedy Algorithm and Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile communication technology, communication networks are becoming more and more complex, and the coverage area of base stations becomes smaller, and the number of base stations becomes more, which has higher requirements for the construction of mobile communication network. In order to solve the weak coverage problem effectively, this paper takes the coordinate data of a weak coverage grid data and the data samples of the site coordinates of an existing network in a fixed area of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2500^{\ast}2500$</tex> as examples to establish a mathematical model, using K-Means clustering method for data cleaning and noise processing. Greedy algorithm and DBSCAN density clustering algorithm are mainly used in the optimal site selection and further optimization of weak coverage problems.

articleTitle: A Mathematical Model to Simulate Self-loosening Behavior of Bolted Joints Due to Thread Wear under Transverse Loading
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: To improve the understanding of the loosening behavior caused by thread wear, a mathematical model of bolted joint with consideration of thread wear was proposed. The method for wear simulation is based on Archard wear equation. The mathematical model simulated the phenomenon where thread wear leads to a gradual reduction in the clamping force by using numerical iterative calculation. The evolutionary trend of the thread wear and clamping force is consistent with the previous test results. The predicted results show that the wear on the thread surface causes a change in the distribution and magnitude of the loads carried by each engaged thread. The thread loads initially tend to be equal, and then all gradually decreases. Besides, the bolt with a higher wear coefficient can obtain a greater ability to resist the self-loosening caused by thread wear, but retightening the bolt and the nut seems not to be a very effective method to resist the loosening caused by thread wear.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv5-based UAV Target Detection under Complex Background
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: A real-time moving target detection algorithm of UAVs based on improved YOLOv5 is proposed to improve the detection precision of moving targets under complex background. Based on YOLOv5, the algorithm uses Convolution Kernel Group (CKG) to enhance the feature extraction of UA V targets under complex background. The Squeeze-Excitation Attention Module (SE) is used to adjust the perception field adaptively to improve the feature extraction ability of targets under complex background. The adaptive spatial feature fusion (ASFF) module enhances the feature extraction ability and feature fusion efficiency of the original model in complex scenes to improve the detection precision of targets under complex background interference. The experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve 75.58% recall, 95.63% precision, and 78.92% mean average precision for moving target detection under complex background. The method can realize the detection of UA V moving targets in complex background, which is conducive to the cause of security and has important significance in anti-terrorism, public security control, and production safety.

articleTitle: Workshop Scheduling that Integrates NSGA-II and CSA
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Addressing the simultaneous scheduling of tasks and Automated Guide Vehicle (AGV) in flexible workshop systems. Consider maximizing utilization with limited resources to save costs as much as possible. Constructed to minimize the maximum machine duration, the consumption time of a single handling robot, and the total transport time of all handling robots as a function of the objective. Design an improved algorithm (INGCSA) that combines NGSA-II (Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithms) and Clonal Selection Algorithm (CSA) to solve such problems. First, the population is layered by nondominated ordering; secondly, cloning of superior and medium populations; Finally, different mutation probabilities are adopted for different levels of population, which effectively retains excellent individuals and prevents the algorithm from falling into local optimum. The simulation results show that the algorithm has good optimization ability, short running time and high stability.

articleTitle: Design and Crash Simulation Research of High-Performance Movable Steel Anti-Collision Barrel Combined with Wave-Shaped Anti-Collision Beam Design
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: As a safety system on the road, the guardrail system is significant for the safety of the vehicle and the driver. This article uses a Ford Taurus model and a designed guardrail model. Three potential guardrails with a good energy absorption effect are analyzed, and the traditional traffic drum guardrail is selected to be transformed and optimized in the final design. Select the material and shape of the guardrail to optimize the design, and analyze the collision situation of the car body through simulation. During the collision, the blocking effect of the guardrail on the car and the intrusion of the cab after the collision are of concern. After analyzing the simulation results, the final guardrail has excellent performance, the added corrugate structure has the effect of energy absorption, and the safety of collision is guaranteed. This analysis method can also be used for any other crashworthiness optimization between the car and the guardrail.

articleTitle: Research on Displacement Measurement Device Dropped with UAV to Apply to Monitoring Geologic Hazard near Pylons in Sichuan-Chongqing Aera
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: It is necessary to monitor geologic hazard near pylons in Sichuan-Chongqing aera by means of displacement measurement. A Displacement Measurement Device (DMD) dropped with Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) should be designed and implemented because it is very difficult to mount the device on the steep mountain. Difference position technology applys in the DMD based on the Beidou satellite navigation system. The appearance of DMD is regular tetrahedral which is very stable when the device lands on either side dropped with UAV. The antennas of the DMD are placed in a sphere which always face the satellite because the spherical structure like a roly-poly toy standing still. The DMDs are mounted on the H08 landslide and H10 landslide, which are potential landslide near pylons in Sichuan-Chongqing aera. The DMDs are dropped with UAV and now are running stably.

articleTitle: Research on Robust Allocation Strategy of Parking Spaces in Large Busy Airports
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In order to evaluate the robustness of the airport slot allocation strategy, the complex network model evolution was used to analyze and describe the slot operation process accurately. Based on the relevant characteristics of network dynamics, an improved SEIR propagation model with more robust applicability is established, and the nodes with different importance levels are classified in the process of slot network. Then, the nodes with varying levels of importance are simulated and analyzed in other time windows. Taking the historical operation data of a busy airport in China as an example, the experimental results show that the airport paralysis degree increases by 44.3 % on average, with an increase of 12.44% in the number of airport node failures. The above results provide a reference for the robustness analysis of the plane allocation strategy.

articleTitle: A Probabilistic Model for JSON Data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: JSON is an exchange data format for applications nowadays. To manage JSON data efficiently, it is important to use a proper model for JSON data. A straightforward model for JSON is a tree-structured model, in which nodes are types of JSON data, and edges are values of the nodes. As uncertainties are common and natural in real environments, it is realistic for a JSON model to deal with uncertainties of JSON data. This paper first analyzes the state-of-art uncertainty in data management fields, including relational database, XML data, and graph data, etc. Then based on the above observations, a probabilistic JSON model is proposed based on the tree model of JSON data is proposed, in which probability settings are incorporated in the (key, value) pairs of JSON model. Finally, JSONPath is extended to deal with probability computing of JSON data queries.

articleTitle: Research on the Balance of Stage of Charge in Distributed Energy Storage Units
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Due to the intermittent and unstable characteristics of distributed new energy generation, the microgrid usually needs to use the energy storage system (ESS) to peak load shifting of the system of power supply to stabilize the system voltage and power balance. Because the low-voltage microgrids have a mismatched line resistance, the traditional droop control method cannot balance the state of charge (SOC) of the distributed energy storage unit(DESU). This paper designs a micro grid distributed energy storage unit stage of charge balancing control strategy based on self-adjusting virtual impedance.

articleTitle: Simulation and Optimization of Emergency Safe Evacuation in College Dormitories
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In order to optimize the safe evacuation route of a university dormitory during the epidemic, Pathfinder software is used to take the dormitory building as the real scene, establish a mathematical model of evacuation time, personnel movement parameters, distance of evacuation stairs, etc. as variables, design different evacuation plans through different choices of three evacuation stairs, and compare evacuation time. The results showed that when dormitory No. 5 and No. 26 took staircase A, dormitory No. 14 took staircase B, and dormitory No. 33 took staircase C, the evacuation time was reduced from 302.8 to 238.5 with the least time, and when the difference in the number of evacuation dormitories with three stairs was small, the difference in the evacuation time of the three stairs was also small. Therefore, college dormitory buildings should design reasonable evacuation routes, which can effectively reduce evacuation time and improve evacuation efficiency. The research results can provide a theoretical basis for the planning and safety management of safe evacuation routes of university dormitory buildings similar to this model.

articleTitle: Research on the Selection of Reverse Logistics Model of Waste Household Appliances Based on the Maximization of Income
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: At present, China attaches great importance to the disposal of waste household appliances, but the recycling market of waste household appliances is still in a state of disorder. Reverse logistics strategy has become an important means for household appliance manufacturers to strengthen their core competition. Manufacturers need to choose appropriate reverse logistics mode according to their own conditions. This paper will study the selection of reverse logistics mode of waste electrical appliances, build a mathematical model of maximizing revenue and solve it. Taking Company M as an example, the validity and rationality of the model and algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: The Simulation of Fresnel Lens for Adjusting Parameters: The Simulation Fresnel Lens Application for Improving the Conversion Efficiency of Photovoltaic Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: This paper introduces the principle of Fresnel lens and the design process of comsol simulation. In our App module based on comsol, we have designed Fresnel lens simulation with all parameters manually adjustable, which can realize the simulation according to the incident light of the sun in different months and different areas in China, in this way we have produced Fresnel lens most suitable for different conditions. The results of this simulation research have shown that the simulation APP has the characteristics of simple structure, convenient using and good testing effect, and will have broad application prospect in the field of photovoltaic solar panel focusing test.

articleTitle: A Real Time Retrieval Method of Massive Arrears User Profile Data Based on HBase
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Due to the large amount, fast speed and incompatibility of the massive arrears users' file data, it has brought some impact on their retrieval work. In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of massive arrears user archive data retrieval, a real-time retrieval method for massive arrears user archive data based on HBase is proposed. Based on the Hadoop architecture, the massive arrears user profile data is collected, the massive arrears user profile data is linearly converted, the dimensions are reduced, and the massive arrears user profile data is preprocessed. On this basis, HBase storage model and HBase two-level fast index are established to realize real-time retrieval of massive arrears user file data based on HBase. The experimental results show that the retrieval accuracy of the proposed method is 97.6%, and the retrieval time is only 6.8 ms, which can effectively improve the retrieval accuracy and efficiency of the massive arrears user file data.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Analysis of HLTZ60-LJ-233 Water Turbine Transformation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In order to study the internal flow state of the mixed-flow turbine, this paper takes the modified HLTZ60-LJ-233 model turbine as the research object, combines with the modeling software UG, uses the grid division software ICEM, and then imports the flow field analysis software Fluent, and the turbine full-flow flow field analysis based on the k- ω turbulence model.

articleTitle: Self-Supervised Robotic Arm Sorting Control Method Based on Dual-Channel VPG
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: The gripping problem of the robotic arm has been widely studied, and the control task after gripping is still important in this paper. This paper proposes a dual-channel predictive network structure based on the VPG (Visual Pushing for Grasping) algorithm, which improves the stability of the policy compared with VPG, and then extends the control task of the robotic arm to sorting and designs a self-supervised sorting algorithm without recognition and segmentation. The paper proposes a dual-channel fusion VPG network structure to improve the stability of the deep reinforcement learning policy. The simulation results show that the optimized grasping algorithm achieves 83.3%-97.8% grasping success rate in an environment with several randomly placed objects, which improves the stability and grasping success rate of the policy compared with the original algorithm VPG, and achieves 87%-100% grasping success rate and 83.5%-96.29% sorting success rate in the sorting task. It also reduces the probability of dropping the robot arm during the sorting and placing of objects.

articleTitle: A Method of Abnormal Measurement Screening for Special Transformer Users Based on Correlation Measurement Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of measurement anomaly identification for users of special transformers, this paper proposes a method of measurement anomaly screening for users of special transformers based on correlation measurement algorithm. Based on the monitoring results of user measurement data of special transformer in the abnormal monitoring sub module program, the ontology model of user measurement data of special transformer is constructed. On this basis, the user measurement data of special transformer substation is collected, and the data distribution model of user measurement similarity of special transformer substation is constructed based on the correlation measurement algorithm. Filter and screen the global information through the filter to realize the abnormal data of measurement data of special transformer users and complete the abnormal screening of measurement data of special transformer users. The experimental results show that the proposed method has a good performance in the screening of user measurement anomalies in special transformers.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Location Based on Wolf Pack Optimization Algorithm Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In the actual bearings-only passive UAV positioning system, the UAV without standard position can't perform three-point positioning by geometric algorithm. This paper introduces how to locate the UAV when it is in an abnormal position and adjust it to the standard position. Firstly, the error distance between the original position and its accurate position is taken as the target, and a fitting optimization model is established. Finally, based on the hybrid genetic wolf pack optimization algorithm, the point with smaller error distance is taken as the wolf king of the population, and the wolf king with weak capture ability is eliminated by continuous genetic iteration. When the optimal distance is captured, the distance of the UAV is regarded as the standard distance.

articleTitle: Research on simulation analysis method of RAIKO P15 ice-roller tool vibration crushing compacted ice-snow
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: The ground-excited ice-roller has been able to effectively solve the problem of ice-snow on the roads, but its ice breaking mechanism, operating parameters and efficiency still need to be studied and improved. This paper, taking effect of RAIKO P15 ground-excited ice-roller tool vibration crushing ice-snow as the research content, established a finite element model of tool and compacted ice-snow by using ANSYS/LS-DYNA, realized the simulation analysis of the process of ice-roller tool crushing compacted ice-snow, obtained the crushing effect of 10mm thick compacted ice-snow and the stress distribution of tool under different vibration frequencies, and determined that the optimized vibration frequency of ice-roller is 25 kHz. The simulation method and analysis result in this paper provide the method and basis for the design and manufacture of ice-snow removal equipment tool.

articleTitle: A Theoretical Study of Metacellular Automata Considering the Evacuation Behavior of Personnel Stairs
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: To consider the different evacuation behaviors of personnel stairs in the step area, convergence area, and turning area and to achieve the purpose of step area velocity in steps/S, a hybrid metacellular automata model is proposed, which is a mixture of triangular and quadrilateral meshes. The mathematical formulation of the hybrid metacellmodel, the neighbor model, and other concepts are derived, and the simulation of the actual scenario is successfully carried out, and the results show that the evacuation behavior of people in the staircase in the actual scenario is more closely matched.

articleTitle: Water quality prediction model based on GRA and CNN-GRU
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Water quality prediction plays a very important role in the prevention and control of water pollution. As the river water quality factors are time-series, uncertainty and correlation, in order to improve the prediction accuracy of water quality prediction model, a combined water quality prediction model based on gray correlation algorithm (GRA) and CNN-GRU combined model is proposed. Four common water quality indicators of chemical oxygen demand, dissolved oxygen, total phosphorus and total nitrogen in the water quality of Taihu Lake basin were selected for data prediction, and benchmark models such as GRU and LSTM were compared. The experimental results show that the predicted values of the combined GRA-CNN-GRU model fit better with the actual values, and the RMSE, MAE and MAPE errors are reduced compared with other models, and the model prediction effect is better

articleTitle: Emergency Evacuation Simulation of Urban Rail Transit Station
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Under the background of increasing urban population and increasing ground transportation pressure in China, the urban rail transit system has gradually become the main artery of urban transportation because of its independent right of way, but the emergency evacuation capacity of urban rail transit stations in the face of excessive passenger density and complex passenger flow is still obviously insufficient. To solve this problem, based on the classification of facilities in urban rail transit stations and the movement law of passengers under emergency evacuation, the fire accident at Fuxingmen Station of Beijing Metro was taken as an example to construct a simulation environment, and simulation parameters were set to study the evacuation time, guidance strategy and other issues of emergency evacuation of urban rail transit stations. Through AnyLogic simulation, it is found that adding evacuation guidance can reduce the total evacuation time by 127.39s, save the evacuation time and provide valuable escape opportunities for passengers. This work can provide theoretical guidance for the research on emergency evacuation of stations, and provide reference for the operation and management of enterprises.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Spray Characteristics of Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Simulation method is used to study the fuel spray characteristics under different fuel injection conditions and environmental conditions. By introducing the basic governing equation of fluid, turbulence model and KH-RT crushing model into CONVERGE, the spray characteristics under different nozzle diameter (0.15mm, 0.18mm,0.21mm) and ambient back pressure (2MPa, 3MPa,4MPa) were studied. The results show that the spray penetration distance and cone angle at 0.21mm aperture are obviously larger than those at 0.18mm and 0.15mm aperture.

articleTitle: MI-EEG Recognition Based on Euclidean Alignment and Style Transfer Mapping
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: To improve the efficiency and universality of transfer learning in the application process of motor imagery (MI) brain-computer interface (BCI), we propose a classification recognition framework for MI-BCI. We use Euclidean alignment (EA) to align electroencephalogram (EEG) signals obtained after preprocessing, then regularized common spatial pattern (RCSP) is used to remove the redundancy information of the signals. We use a transfer learning (TL) algorithm based on feature mapping to carry out specific knowledge transfer so that the classifier on the source domain can be transferred to the target domain for classification recognition. The experiment results show that the average classification accuracy of the framework on data sets 1 and 2a of the BCI competition IV have increased significantly compared with recent literature.

articleTitle: Study on the surrounding rock failure law and repair and support technology of roadway in deep fully mechanized mining face based on computer simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: The deep-buried fully mechanized mining Face of coal mines is located in a complex stress environment, high in-situ stress level, high dynamic pressure, easy to deform and damage, and complex deformation laws along the trench confining pressure. Based on the transportation channel of Yuhua Coal Mine 2410 working Face, the deformation and failure mechanism of the surrounding rock of the deep-buried channel under complex conditions and its support scheme are studied through indoor tests and field measurements, and the theory of “supporting surrounding rock loose ring” is used. Carrying out support parameter design, using FLAC finite difference method numerical simulation software to verify the rationality of the support plan. Field monitoring showed that the roof displacement was obviously suppressed after the support was optimized, the anchor cable force was stable, and the groove deformation was controlled.

articleTitle: Intelligent Layout Method of Power Line
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In order to better solve the problems of low efficiency, error prone and low reusability along the line, this solution provides an idea to solve this problem by automatically analyzing the planning rules. Planning rules refer to various influencing factors that need to be considered during route drawing. Through the definition of rules, rules are used to guide the drawing of lines. Through the automatic analysis of the program and the application of rules, the efficiency of lines along the cloth can be greatly improved. First, you can define common avoidance rules and follow rules in the rule definition function as required, and support intelligent definition, so as to meet the requirements of modifying rule details through parameter configuration. Nest, through the rule customization technology, when the line is laid along, the user-defined rules are applied to judge the line along the layout, and the rule items are used to replace the manual judgment to achieve the high efficiency and accuracy of the line along the layout.

articleTitle: Prediction method of sulfur solubility based on BP neural network model and Chrastil model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Scholars at home and abroad have built many sulfur solubility prediction models based on Chrastil empirical correlation model, but its calculation accuracy and application conditions are still insufficient. Accordingly, the sulfur solubility was predicted based on BP neural network model, and a new sulfur solubility prediction model was established according to Chrastil empirical correlation. The model avoids the disadvantages of high experiment cost and high operation risk, and has the characteristics of high calculation accuracy of BP neural network prediction model, simple calculation of Chrastil empirical correlation and high mine practicability. The average absolute fitting error is only 5.89%, which can provide theoretical research basis for sulfur deposition.

articleTitle: Emotional Recognition Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Recently, emotional recognition based on machine learning algorithm has gained greater attention. Considering python has an excellent open-source model PyEEG which is especially made for dealing with EEG signal, and rich machine learning models, so we choose python as our tool. In this paper we have applied the analysis on DEAP: a database using physiological signal aiming for emotion analysis, which records arousal, valence, like/dislike levels, dominance and familiarity of 32 participants after watching 40 fragments of music videos. We use fast Fourier transform (FFT), “frequency ratio” and permutation entropy method to extract features from the dataset and divide the training set (80%) and the test set (20%), then build a three-dimensional convolution model(3D-CNN) to train them. Finally, we have achieved high precision (99.73%).

articleTitle: Lateral Stability Analysis and Equivalent Circuit Simulation of Double-Axis Bogie
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: The stability of the bogie limits the maximum safe operating speed of the vehicle. The analytical methods are diverse and have their own characteristics. In this paper, the dynamics equation of the double-axis bogie model is established. The critical velocity is calculated by Matlab, and the reduced order is converted into an equation of state according to the characteristics of the mathematical model. The analog circuits of addition and subtraction, differentiation and integration, which are composed of resistive and capacitive elements and operational amplifiers, are mathematically equivalent. The equivalent circuit simulation and numerical simulation established by Multisim are compared and analyzed, and the simulation results are basically the same, which indicates that the equivalent circuit not only has the advantages of real-time parameter adjustment and fast calculation speed, but also has good equivalence and feasibility, which provides a reference to the research and analysis of mechanical system dynamics.

articleTitle: EEG Emotion Recognition Based on Graph Signal and Stable Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In order to extract effective information from Electroencephalography (EEG) data, this paper proposes an EEG emotion recognition method based on graph signal and stable learning. To simulate the integration of information by the brain, the EEG data is endowed with spatial structure, that is, it is modeled as a graph signal, and the graph Fourier transform is used to transform the initial graph signal into a graph signal in the frequency domain, and then the graph convolution neural network is used to automatically extract the more discriminating features of the data with graph structure for emotion classification. In addition, in order to extract the causal features in EEG channels, we used the weight learning of decorrelation to remove confounding factors and exclude correlation features. The proposed method is tested on two public datasets for binary valence and arousal, and the classification accuracy is better than other similar methods.

articleTitle: Aircraft Mission Reliability Evaluation Based on Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: The level of mission reliability determines whether the aircraft can exert its full operational effectiveness when performing a mission. The application of traditional numerical calculation methods in mission reliability evaluation is limited, and simulation methods are gradually paid attention to. This paper analyzes the system composition and mission profile of the aircraft, constructs the mission reliability model by using the reliability block diagram, expresses the logical relationship of the mission reliability block diagram by Boolean operation, improves the traditional Monte Carlo simulation method, and introduces the concept of working state sequence to realize the multi-phase mission reliability calculation. The simulation program is written by Python, and verified by an example. The results show that the evaluation method has high availability.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Network Reliability for Avionics Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Reliability is a critical performance for airborn communication networks, and it is heavily influenced by network topology. Redundant designs might improve reliability, but the increased weight, cost, and complexity must be taken into account. This paper focuses on the reliabiltiy analysis of different topologies of network in airborn communication applications, and the comprehensive impact of redundancy mechanisms on its reliability performance. A network reliability simulation method based on the minimum path set algorithm and Monte Carlo simulation method is designed, and quantitative comparison and analysis of two frequently used airborn topologies and their dual redundancy forms are carried out. According to simulation results, the dual-loop topology is suitable for building the backbone network of the airborn communication system, and the dual-bus topology is suitable for some critical subnet systems with stricter reliability requirements.

articleTitle: Design and Modelling of a Micro Flow Sensor Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: With the progress of the research on MEMS, the traditional industry and fluid mechanics research of flow sensor reach to the high level of integration, miniaturization, high precision, high reliability direction. At the same time, the development of life science greatly promoted for microfluidics, study subjects such as biology, medicine, health have also improved the development of new type micro flow sensor. Micro flow sensor has become an important research direction. In this paper, based on the MEMS manufacturing process, a flow sensor with a titanium layer of 300 nm is designed and simulated by using FEM software in the environment of machining thickness of 100 nm grade and flow rate of microliter grade. Simulation result shows that when applying a flow rate of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10\ \mu\mathrm{L}/\min$</tex>, temperature difference <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Delta\mathrm{T}$</tex> between the two temperature sensors is about 12°C to 14°C.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Study on Flow Heat Transfer in Waste Heat Boiler of Zinc Concentrate Fluidized Roasting Furnace
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: The numerical model of the heat boiler of the zinc concentrate fluidized roasting furnace was built. The standard <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k-\varepsilon$</tex> model was used to capture the turbulence effect of the high temperature air in the large boiler area. The compressible gas model was used in the gas-wall heat transfer. The results of the velocity and temperature filed show that the boiler could successfully recover the heat in the gas. The most effective heat recover area was found and the structure of the tube screen could be improved.

articleTitle: Environmental Optimization Analysis of Outdoor Flow Field of a Campus Building in Changzhi City, Shanxi Province via CFD Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Energy is becoming a growing concern in the twenty-first century, and energy saving in buildings is a very important development direction, and CFD simulation can greatly understand the flow field distribution around the building to achieve the goal of building energy savings. The outdoor flow field environment of a campus building in Changzhi City, Shanxi Province, is used as an example for optimization analysis in this paper. The design first employs fluid calculation software to simulate the building's external flow field with CFD, then adjusts the orientation and layout of the building based on the simulation results, and adds more structures to ensure that the building can maximize the use of natural ventilation to reduce indoor load in summer and have a small amount of cold air infiltration in winter. According to the results of the paper, the CFD simulation demonstrates that the solution can make better use of natural ventilation to reduce the summer load, and that for the winter load, the cold wind infiltration velocity of the entire teaching building and some major places of the complex building will decrease, but will increase the load of other buildings, such as the art and sports building.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Three-Phase Balanced Power Supply for Vehicle Mobile Power
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: This paper analyzed the harm of three-phase unbalanced power supply of vehicle mobile power supply to generator set electrical equipment and communication system, and the cause of the harm is analyzed. The three-phase balance control box is designed by adopting the design concept of “three input one output” and “rectifier inverter”. Through the comparison of the experimental data, the feasibility of the three-phase balance control box for the three-phase balance adjustment of the external power supply of the vehicle mobile power supply is verified, so as to achieves the optimization of the three-phase balance power supply and improves the reliability and safety of the external power supply of the vehicle mobile power supply.

articleTitle: Research on Prediction of Telecommunication and Electronic Manufacturing Industry Prosperity Index
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Based on the electricity information of more than 800 key energy-consuming enterprises in a city, this study obtained high-frequency and structured electricity consumption data through data cleaning and sorting. Based on the production theory in economics, complex network model and Hidden Markov algorithm were used to establish a prediction model for the prosperity index of communication and electronic manufacturing industry. The accuracy of the predicting model is verified by the actual value of output growth. In the last two months, it is forecasted that the production economy of this industry has decreased first and then increased, showing a recovery trend. The model can objectively reflect the operation of the industry and plays a role in predicting the economy of a city.

articleTitle: Household Demand Analysis of New Energy Battery in Household Solar Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Solar energy refers to the conversion of the energy of sunlight into electrical energy, which can provide electricity for household appliances. However, solar energy cannot be used directly on cloudy days or at night. The purpose of this paper is to design a new energy battery pack purchase plan for the household solar power generation system for a family to save solar energy for use at night and on a cloudy day. We first estimate the electricity consumed by this house in one night and on a cloudy day based on indicators such as the power rating and working hours. Then the price of the energy storage system is taken as the main consideration to establish an integer linear programming model. Based on the results of this model, we give the best selections for different types of batteries. In addition, we adjust and generalize the established integer linear programming model so that it is adaptable to different needs and preferences to choose the best battery storage. The battery capacity preference, the continuous power supply preference, and the instantaneous power preference are studied, respectively.

articleTitle: Estimation of Equipment Remaining Useful Life based on WTEE- RNN Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Nuclear power plants have a large number of safety or non-safety related mechanical equipment. Knowing when and where these equipment failure or near failure is one of the key problems in nuclear safety and nuclear health management and maintenance, that is to predict the remaining useful life for specific equipment. A prediction model labeled as Weibull time to event recurrent neural network (WTTE-RNN) is proposed to effectively obtain the prediction and estimation of time to event (such as customer churn, patient survival, machine failure). The model is effective even under some missing-spots in the training data (i.e. deleted data). The purpose of this research is to study the main challenges faced by the application of WTTE-RNN to the nuclear equipment, and identify feasible optimization directions. The results may lay a foundation for the WTTE-RNN application to the remaining useful life.

articleTitle: A CPS-Oriented Combinatorial Modeling and Model Conversion Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: At present, cyber-physical systems are widely used in avionics, telemedicine, automotive electronics and other fields, and the software and hardware subsystems in cyber-physical systems are closely coupled with each other, but the existing modeling language cannot describe both discrete and continuous parts of the system separately, so we use SysML and Modelica to model the software, hardware parts of the cyber-physical system. In order to combine SysML and Modelica more conveniently, we establish communication rules at the metamodel level, and add probabilistic attributes in the behavior attachment of SysML to describe the probabilistic behavior of the system. For the convenience of verification, we transform this semi-formal model into a probabilistic mixture interface automaton(PHIA) through transformation rules, so as to carry out formal verification. Finally, the feasibility of the combined modeling method and conversion algorithm proposed in this paper is verified by an unmanned driving system.

articleTitle: Parallel Simulation Technology Based on Ontology and Relationship
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Parallel simulation technology is the key to apply simulation to the construction of battle command information system, in order to solve the problem of construction and correction of entity ontology-relationship models in parallel simulation, this paper analyzes the differences between the two evolution modes: force-based simulation evolution and organization-based simulation evolution, puts forwards simulation framework based on ontology and relationship, constructs the dynamic construction method of entity ontology model and entity relationship model, designs model modification rules, and takes a typical combat as an example for simulation experiments to verify the feasibility of the proposal.

articleTitle: Study on Carbon Fixation Based on Carbon Sequestration Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: At present, the global climate has changed significantly. The impact of greenhouse gases on global climate has become a consensus, and CO2 as the most important greenhouse gas has attracted more and more attention. In this paper, carbon sequestration model was established to compare carbon fixation under different cutting conditions. By establishing a decision-making model, the most efficient forest management scheme is proposed for forest managers. Based on the relative growth model, we use the average method, through the biomass equation to calculate the related constant, to construct a carbon storage model. Furthermore, based on the carbon sequestration model, the decision-making model was employed to find the transition point of the forest. Finally, we conclude that after applying the carbon sequestration model, we took 5% of deforestation after 77 years as the maximum value for deforestation. At this point, we can not only achieve carbon fixation, but also protect forest biodiversity and ensure the water-saving capacity of forests. At the same time, we can also provide more wood for the production of wood products. We consider this the most effective forest management plan and the best balance point.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic Inflation Characteristics of the Large-Size Gasbag with Multiple Nozzles Based on the Fluid-Structure Interaction Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: To meet the needs of the airborne dispenser to disperse large-mass bullets, the dynamic inflation process of the large-size gasbag with two nozzles and three nozzles is numerically simulated and analyzed using the fluid-structure interaction method. The calculated final expansion shape of the gasbag is in good agreement with the experimental results. According to the changing law of the expansion velocity, the dynamic inflation process of the gasbag can be divided into three stages in which the gas shock, the pressure in the gasbag and the stress on the gasbag wall are respectively the main factors affecting the expansion of the gasbag. Under the same propellant charge, there is a phenomenon of hysteresis in the expansion height and the expansion velocity of the gasbag with two nozzles. The pressure in the gasbag with three nozzles is higher and more evenly distributed. Therefore, the final expanded shape of the gasbag with three nozzles is fuller than that of the gasbag with two nozzles. However, this also leads to a more serious deformation of the folds on the end surfaces of the gasbag with three nozzles, and the maximum stress at the folds is 824.5 MPa greater than that of two-nozzles gasbag.

articleTitle: Research on Conversion of 3D CAD Model Into Monte Carlo Models Based on SALOME
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In nuclear reactor design analysis, Monte Carlo (MC) programs are widely used for simulation calculations of particle transport. Traditionally, MC program input files are constructed by manual creation, but with the increasing complexity of advanced nuclear reactor models, the traditional input file construction method can no longer meet the application requirements, and it is important to develop an auxiliary modeling program for MC programs. In this paper, based on the open source platform SALOME, we conducted a study on the conversion of CAD 3D geometric model to MC computational model using decomposition-based BREP-CSG conversion algorithm and cavity generation algorithm, and developed an auxiliary modeling program MOSRT. Based on the MOSRT program, the user can create or import CAD 3D geometry models and convert them into MC program input files corresponding to the geometry through the program. To verify the effectiveness of the MOSRT program model conversion function, the NEA published benchmark example C5G7 model and the critical experimental device model were used for geometric verification. The results show that the MOSRT program developed based on the method of this paper can accurately convert the CAD 3D geometric model into the corresponding MC program calculation model, which verifies the correctness and reliability of the methods and program of this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Launch Control System Based on ARM and FPGA Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Aiming at the high reliability design problem of electromagnetic launch control system, this paper proposes a control system design method based on ARM and FPGA architecture. The overall structure of the control system is divided into three parts: box control, subsystem control and module control. Among them, the subsystem controller is composed of a control motherboard and a pulse power management board. The control motherboard is designed based on the architecture of ARM and FPGA. ARM runs logic related processing, and FPGA processes timing control, synchronous feedback and other functions that require high time accuracy. Based on the host computer software, the current curves of specific discharge energy and discharge time sequence are analyzed. The verification results show that the discharge current waveform can be controlled by controlling the discharge sequence of Pulse Forming Network (PFN) through the control system. Under the condition of long equal interval discharge sequence, the peak current decreases and the wave pattern changes gently. The electromagnetic launch control system realized in this paper has high scalability, can monitor more than twenty pulse power units, and can achieve highly reliable control of the launch system based on single shot and continuous shot operation mode.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation on Diffusion Properties of Water-Soluble Demulsifier in Ideal Container
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Water-soluble demulsifiers mainly use water-soluble solvents such as alcohol. Compared with traditional oil soluble solvents, they are cheap and environmentally friendly. In a sense, numerical simulation has a deeper and more detailed understanding of the problem than theory and experiment, and can analyze the diffusion process from a more microscopic perspective. In this paper, the diffusion process of water-soluble demulsifiers at different flow rates is studied by combining the traditional chemical synthesis e-valuation test with modern numerical simulation technology, which opens a new way for related experiments.

articleTitle: Data Storage and Sharing Scheme Based on Hyperledger Fabric
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: As academic research becomes more and more international, close cooperation between different research institutions has become a key factor in promoting the development of science and technology. Research teams and institutions in different countries urgently need an effective and secure online platform for collaboration and data sharing. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a scientific research data storage and sharing scheme based on Hyperledger Fabric, which combines blockchain technology with interplanetary file system and effectively relieves the storage pressure of blockchain network. The multi-channel architecture is designed to protect scientific research data based on physical isolation of different channel ledger data. In addition, through proxy re-encryption, a fine-grained permission control scheme for user data is designed and implemented. The data receiver can decrypt the ciphertext without obtaining the key of the sender. In this way, the private key and plaintext of the sender are not leaked during data sharing, which improves data privacy and achieves data sharing. Finally, Docker technology was used to build a test environment, and the system was tested for function and performance, which verified the feasibility of the scheme system.

articleTitle: Global Existence of Incompressible Viscous Fluid Coupled with the $\alpha$-Heat-Conductive
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In this paper, we consider the following <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\alpha}$</tex> -heat-conductive coupled with the incompressible viscous fluid. We give the global existence and decay estimates of a Cauchy problem.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Optimized LeNet-5
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a feedforward neural network, is widely used in large-scale machine learning tasks such as image recognition, image classification, and object detection. Although CNN has strong performance, its application in daily embedded systems is limited due to the complex network hierarchy and a large amount of data. In this paper, the LeNet-5 network structure is optimized. The recognition accuracy of the optimized network on the MNIST dataset is 98.32%, but the number of weights is reduced by more than ten times compared with the LeNet-5 network, and data quantization is used to convert the weights into 8-bit fixed-point numbers, which is more suitable for deployment in the hardware with limited resources and power consumption. At the same time, different hardware structures and optimization strategies are designed for each layer of the network, and the convolution, pooling and fully connected layers are computed in parallel and optimized using methods such as loop unrolling and pipelining. Finally, the feasibility of the hardware design is verified by simulating each layer using the MNIST dataset and quantized weights.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Calculation Method of Takeoff and Landing Running Distance for New Type Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In order to accurately calculate the required runway length of the new aircraft, this paper establishes and solves the differential equation of aircraft take-off and landing through the aircraft taxiing dynamics and kinematics theory. Considering the aircraft's parameters and environmental parameters, the Simulink simulation model of aircraft take-off and landing is built, and a new runway length calculation method is studied. On this basis, compared with the actual flight distance data, the results show that the relative error range between flight speed and flight distance is about 3%, indicating that the accuracy of the calculation method is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Study on Static Stiffness Characteristics and Influencing Factors of Radial Pneumatic Tire with Complex Tread Patterns by Computer Simulation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: To study the static stiffness characteristics of radial pneumatic tire with complex tread patterns, a numerical simulation model of radial pneumatic tire is established based on the finite element method (FEM), and its accuracy is verified by the outer contour experiment and grounding experiment. The influence of different inflation pressure and cord angle on the radial stiffness of the tire, and the response of the lateral stiffness and longitudinal stiffness of the tire when the pressure and load change are analyzed. The results show that the relationship between tire pressure and radial stiffness is approximately cubic polynomial, and the increase of tire radial stiffness at high pressure is greater than that at low pressure. The increase of air pressure will increase the lateral stiffness of the tire, but the increase is not large. Before the relative slip between the tire and the road surface, the load has little effect on the lateral stiffness and longitudinal stiffness. The research results provide a basis for the structural design of radial tire.

articleTitle: Improve the Traditional Autoencoder Student Classroom Behavior Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Most of the existing behavior recognition methods are aimed at the dynamic behavior in action. When applied to the static behavior recognition environment in the classroom, it is difficult to achieve the ideal effect and waste computing resources. Therefore, aiming at the specific environment of classroom, the paper firstly describes the model theories of traditional Auto Encoder (AE) and Variational Auto Encoder (VAE). On this basis, the optimized variational autoencoder (AVAE) model structure proposed in this paper for the classroom behavior recognition of students is introduced. By loading the encoder with pre-training weight, the feature extraction results are obtained, and the loss function is optimized to reduce the supervision of the decoder during training, so as to identify the student behavior more efficiently. The AVAE model is compared with the current common deep learning feature extraction classification methods, and the performance advantages of the proposed method are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Simulation of UAV Interception and Countermeasure Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: The simulation computer is the main body of the system, and the hardware and software of the system are designed on the basis of considering the two functional requirements of integrated UAV interception and counter-simulation. Firstly, the voices of unmanned aerial vehicles, birds and people within 100 m are collected, preprocessed and extracted with MFCC+GFCC eigenvalues, and their eigenvalues are used as data sets for learning and recognition by convolutional neural networks. Then, the interception model of UAV route planning based on convolutional neural network algorithm and the corresponding deception jamming counter-measure model are expounded. The model effect is simulated and evaluated by computer, and the convergence speed of the algorithm is discussed. The power and optimal deployment position and number of jammers are simulated under the condition that no base station is intercepted in 50 interception routes, thus proving the availability and accuracy of the jammer position planning model.

articleTitle: Coupling Technology Based on DE+FSM+CT Architecture for CAE Software
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: CAE software plays an important role in the application of designing complex equipment. In this paper, we propose coupling technology for full-link CAE software based on DE+FSM+CT architecture oriented to complex equipment. First, we present the componentization technology of CAE software based on multi-agent system framework. The core component library of CAE software is decomposed into multiple software components, following the DEVS specification. This work decouples the CAE life cycle into multiple components, which is helpful for studying the product design under the action of multi-factor coupling. Next, we propose the construction technology CAE multi-module combination model based on DE+FSM+CT architecture. The automatic coupling software component supports multi-module fusion models of physics module, parameters module and numerical solving module in a hierarchical manner. This work models the association and data flow between coupled components, which is an important foundation to support resource scheduling in cross-domain heterogeneous computing and adaptive computing in the cloud platform. We experiment by taking the shield tail part of the shield machine as an example, and show the results of each modeling phase. The experimental results show the superiority of the coupling technique of CAE software for modeling and simulation.

articleTitle: Research on new energy consumption dispatching with high energy consumption flexible loads based on load aggregator
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Conventional power supply is replaced by large-scale renewable energy. In this scenario, the regulation capacity of the power supply side is constantly limited, but the proportion of the load side, especially the flexible load, is increasing year by year. Flexible load has become an important regulation means of power grid due to its fast response, high economy and other operating characteristics. It plays an important role in peak regulation, frequency modulation, new energy consumption and auxiliary decision-making services for the power grid. This paper focuses on the operation model of high energy consumption flexible load, the adjustable power of load, and the mechanism of flexible load participating in new energy consumption. It aims to solve a series of scientific problems and key technologies involved in mining the stock load resources, and provide a theoretical basis and technical reference for the safe and economic operation of the new power system.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis on Motorcyclist's Head Injury in Vehicle-Motorcycle Collision Accident
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: The collision process of vehicle-motorcycle, motion state of motorcyclist after collision are simulated and researched by PC-Crash, called world-famous traffic accident simulation and reconstruction software. Moreover, the head injury of motorcyclist is simulated by PC-Crash in this paper. The influence of typical factors such as collision speed, collision angle on the HIC value of motorcyclist's head is investigated, and the injury law of motorcyclist's head in vehicle-motorcycle collision accidents is summarized. The simulation method used in this paper can be used to identify vehicle-motorcycle accidents.

articleTitle: Optimization Modeling of Spinning Frame Equipment Resource Allocation in a Textile Factory Based on Multi-objective
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In the context of intelligent manufacturing strategy, advanced planning scheduling, also known as APS, as a part of it, faces resource allocation problems in many industries, including manpower, time, use of equipment and so on. In this paper, in order to weigh the production volume as much as possible and maximize the utilization rate of equipment, the multi-objective optimization modeling method is used to solve the spinning process equipment resource allocation problem in the spinning production line of APS project which is cooperated with a textile company in Shandong. The number of different types of equipment allocated by specific orders is determined as the decision variable. Considering the constraints of the number of different types of equipment, the type of equipment processing orders, the order production volume and so on. The linear programming model of equipment allocation in the spinning process is constructed with the maximum order production volume and the minimum number of idle spindles as multi-optimization objectives. It is solved by SCIP solver. Finally, the reliability and correctness of the optimization model constructed in this paper are verified by the actual spinning equipment allocation results in the factory. The research in this paper provides a reasonable scheme for the equipment resource allocation in producting process of spinning production line.

articleTitle: FastDogleg: Acceleration Techniques for Optimization of Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VSLAM) is a research hotspot in the fields of autonomous driving, robotics and computer vision. One of the most important factors that affects the running speed is the optimization algorithm. In this paper, we present a fast and efficient algorithm called FastDogleg. This method can improve the system's overall running speed without affecting its accuracy. We improve the step selection strategy of Dogleg algorithm, which eliminates the dependence on the result of the Newton-Gaussian method at each step; Also, we design the iteration Forced to Exit (FE) strategy to eliminate more errors with fewer iterations; In addition, we adopt the parallel computation to accelerate the construction of the Hessian matrix. Compared with the current popular LM and Dogleg algorithms, the efficiency of the proposed algorithm is more than 3 times higher, which validates the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Numerical Study of Construction Ventilation in the Diversion Tunnels with Long Vertical Shafts
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Ventilation during shaft construction is one of the key issues in the construction process of tunnel projects. In this study, numerical simulation is conducted to investigate the ventilation during the construction period of a diversion tunnel project containing deep shafts. The distribution laws of the flow field and CO concentration field at the junction of the shaft and the flat tunnel are analyzed. The CO concentration under different time periods was also quantified and analyzed, and the CO distribution law at the typical location of the shaft was obtained. The influence mechanism of vertical cross structure and air pressure difference on the ventilation of the shaft during the construction period was investigated. The results show that there are obvious vortex zones at the intersection of the shaft and the flat tunnel, and at the lower part of the shaft expansion section, which can seriously affect the ventilation efficiency during construction. The transport diffusion of CO is closely related to the structure of the tunnel. The flow field and the distribution law of harmful gases derived in this study can be extended to other similar projects.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vortex Cavitation and Throttling Characteristics in Unsteady Large Eddy Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: In this paper, the vortex cavitation and throttling characteristics of the tunable cavitation throttling device are analyzed by combining the Schnerr-Sauer and Zwart-Gerbe-Belamri cavitation models for large eddy simulation under unsteady conditions. The results show that reducing the closed cone area formed by the valve core and the flow channel can help improve the cavitation flow velocity in the diffuse section. Increasing the spool engagement cone angle helps to improve the flow coefficient as the spool moves closer to the initial position; The change of outlet pressure cannot essentially change the process of cavitation;The cavitation index shows a logarithmic curve relationship with the decrease of throat diameter; The flow coefficient showed a negative correlation with the increase of throat diameter. By comparison, Schnerr-Sauer model is more sensitive to cavitation.

articleTitle: OmniNeRF: Hybriding Omnidirectional Distance and Radiance Fields for Neural Surface Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: 3D reconstruction from images has wide applications in Virtual Reality and Automatic Driving, where the precision requirement is very high. Ground-breaking research in the neural radiance field (NeRF) by utilizing Multi-Layer Perceptions has dramatically improved the representation quality of 3D objects. Some later studies improved NeRF by building truncated signed distance fields (TSDFs) but still suffer from the problem of blurred surfaces in 3D reconstruction. In this work, this surface ambiguity is addressed by proposing a novel way of 3D shape representation, OmniNeRF. It is based on training a hybrid implicit field of Omni-directional Distance Field (ODF) and neural radiance field, replacing the apparent density in NeRF with omnidirectional information. Moreover, we introduce additional supervision on the depth map to further improve reconstruction quality. The proposed method has been proven to effectively deal with NeRF defects at the edges of the surface reconstruction, providing higher quality 3D scene reconstruction results.

articleTitle: Two-Phase Flow Simulation of Interior Ballistic with Different Sequential Charging Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: The propulsion system uses different charging structures to improve interior ballistic performance. Current research is based on experimental measurements or lumped parameter method to obtain a few of ballistic characteristics, which indirectly reflects the analysis of the parameters distribution requires a complex modeling solution process. In addition, the ignition performance of different charging structures needs to be further studied. These two defects in previous studies limit the feasibility of further optimizing the charging structure. In this paper, the two-dimensional two-phase flow method is used to study the performance of different particle charging structures. Firstly, a two-dimensional two-phase flow mathematical model based on interior ballistic is established, which is directly related to the research basis of the subsequent ballistic performance. Secondly, the multi-scale reaction flows with different particle scale is studied, and the distribution of parameters in the chamber is obtained. Finally, the effect of particle charging sequence on the flow performance in the chamber was studied. The results show that the sequence charging can play a good point flame transfer performance, which provides the possibility for the optimization of various charging structures.

articleTitle: Air Combat Modeling Based on DE+FSM+CT Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computational Modeling, Simulation and Data Analysis (CMSDA)
abstract: Combat modeling is important for simulating real combat scenarios and assisting commanders to optimize the combat plan. In this paper, we propose a combat modeling and simulation system based on DE+FSM+CT architecture for the air defense scenario. Generally, a combat situation can be viewed as a discrete event system exchanging signals and physical interactions between subsystems. Following the DEVS formalism, we develop the system with 3 types of models including the entity model, action model and damage model, which model the combat subjects, combat actions and combat effects respectively. The basic modeling unit of the system is a native model, which is an agent designed based on the DE+FSM+CT architecture. Each agent has independent internal structure, behavior and explicit input/output interfaces, achieving the modeling of combat actions. Multiple agents are connected hierarchically into a coupled multi-agent model to achieve hierarchical modeling of the continuous time system and discrete event system for combat scenario.
